summary: ImProcess module configuration. Select which reconstructors and processors are loaded for this setup.

fields.label: Show parameter panel
fields.tip: Show the ImProcess Parameters dock at startup. Hidden still keeps reconstructor parameters available internally.

fields.label: Show napari layer controls
fields.tip: Show napari's built-in layer controls dock inside the reconstruction viewer.

fields.label: Show reconstruction panel
fields.tip: Show the Reconstruction viewer dock at startup. If hidden, it opens automatically when data is displayed.

fields.label: Show actions panel
fields.tip: Show the ImProcess Actions dock at startup.

fields.label: Show file watcher panel
fields.tip: Show the ImProcess File watcher dock at startup.

fields.label: Show multidata panel
fields.tip: Show the ImProcess Multidata management dock at startup.

fields.label: Show current data panel
fields.tip: Show the ImProcess Current data dock at startup.

fields.label: Show results table panel
fields.tip: Show the ImProcess Results table dock at startup.

fields.label: Show graph panel
fields.tip: Show the optional plot/graph panel in the ImProcess window.

fields.label: Show profile panel
fields.tip: Show the optional line/rectangle profile and fitting panel in the ImProcess window.

fields.label: Show FRC panel
fields.tip: Show the optional Fourier ring correlation panel in the ImProcess window.

fields.label: Show projection panel
fields.tip: Show the optional axis projection panel in the ImProcess window.

fields.label: Show ROI statistics panel
fields.tip: Show the optional ROI statistics panel in the ImProcess window.

fields.label: Show ROI manager panel
fields.tip: Show the optional multi-ROI manager and per-ROI statistics panel in the ImProcess window.

fields.label: Show segmentation panel
fields.tip: Show the optional threshold and connected-component segmentation panel in the ImProcess window.

fields.label: Show PSF resolution panel
fields.tip: Show the optional bead/PSF Gaussian fitting panel in the ImProcess window.

fields.label: Show colocalization panel
fields.tip: Show the optional channel colocalization panel in the ImProcess window.

fields.label: Show multicolor panel
fields.tip: Show the optional three-color strip registration and alignment panel in the ImProcess window.

fields.label: Show file metadata panel
fields.tip: Show the optional HDF5/Zarr/TIFF metadata tree panel in the ImProcess window.

fields.label: Render localizations as point clouds
fields.tip: Draw SMLM localization results as GPU-rendered summed Gaussians (napari-storm) instead of the built-in low-resolution histogram preview. Requires the optional 'storm' extra: pip install imswitch[storm]. Without it this setting has no effect and results keep the preview.

fields.label: Reconstructors
fields.tip: Built-in reconstructor plugin IDs to register for this setup. Select 'monalisa' for MoNaLISA, including the live fast-Gauss path.

fields.label: Processors
fields.tip: Built-in processor plugin IDs to register for this setup. Leave empty to disable processors.
